features.missing_rule: exclude symbol; flat if fewer than 24 valid pure-crypto symbols remain or either common tape has fewer than 18 bars
features.source: organizer-authorized point-in-time Binance USD-M pure-crypto snapshot
transforms: deterministic same-bar centered cross-sectional return rank
mean relative rank on common-market up bars
mean relative rank on common-market down bars
signed smaller-magnitude cross-tape core with disagreement shrinkage

forbidden_or_unused_fields: bar open/high/low or quote volume for signal construction
current executable open or future membership
positions, fills, equity, PnL, drawdown, or evaluator actions
private qualifier or final OOS data
model_refit: all per-bar ranks, tape means, temporal blocks, durability values, and final ranks are recomputed at each scheduled decision from past-only rows
